verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in AI debugging agent and code reviewer. It performs root-cause analysis and Autofix code-fix generation inside the product, and can hand its analysis to a connected coding agent to create pull requests, so users can delegate debugging work to it. Its scope is limited to debugging and review tasks, and it requires a separate subscription. Missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose task delegation beyond debugging and code review, in-depth documentation of the assistant's interaction model, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Seer works as claimed.
